reflection_diagnosis.causal_diagnosis: The current reward has a dominant success_bonus (mean return 18720) that is paid repeatedly per step when both legs contact the pad with low velocities. This is a non-terminal state predicate that fires every step the condition holds, leading to massive reward accumulation (e.g., 46000 in one episode). The policy exploits this by landing early and then staying on the pad to collect the bonus repeatedly, rather than terminating the episode. This explains the high generated reward (19065) but only 60% success-like terminal rate, because the policy sometimes times out while collecting the bonus.
reflection_diagnosis.component_interaction_diagnosis: The success_bonus dominates all other components (dominance_ratio 41.79). Dense progress signals (distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward) are small relative to the objective bonus (dense_to_objective_ratio 0.0011). The engine penalties are mild and do not counteract the farming behavior. The crash_penalty is only applied at termination, so it does not prevent the policy from staying on the pad indefinitely.
reflection_diagnosis.action_coverage_diagnosis: All four discrete actions are used (coverage_ratio 1.0). The dominant action is 2 (main engine) at 40.7%, followed by 3 (right orientation) at 35.1%, 1 (left orientation) at 23.7%, and 0 (do nothing) at 0.5%. Since all actions are already used, the issue is not action coverage but trajectory-phase guidance: the policy learns to reach the pad and then stay there, rather than completing the episode.
reflection_diagnosis.failed_pattern_reuse_check: The current reward already has a single_component_dominance pattern (success_bonus dominates). The previous edit pattern of using a large per-step success bonus is rejected. This revision will not repeat that pattern; instead, it will convert the success bonus to a one-shot terminal event and condition engine bonuses on progress/phase.

edit_summary.reason: Convert success_bonus from repeatable per-step payment to one-shot terminal-aligned event. Condition engine bonuses on progress/phase to prevent farming. Keep dense progress signals bounded. Add success_flag diagnostic.
changed_design: success_bonus: changed from per-step payment (100 per step when condition holds) to one-shot terminal bonus (100 only at termination if success condition met). Added success_flag to track if bonus was paid.
main_engine_penalty: changed from -0.03 * m_power to -0.03 * m_power * (1 - both_legs_contact) to reduce penalty when already landed (discourage hovering on pad).
orientation_engine_penalty: changed from -0.01 * s_power to -0.01 * s_power * (1 - both_legs_contact) to reduce penalty when already landed.
required_edits_implemented: Make completion/objective bonuses one-shot or terminal-aligned so they cannot fire every step.
Remove repeatable proxy-success payment modes that can be farmed without episode completion.
Keep dense progress signals bounded and smaller than episode-scale objective signals.
Add diagnostics for success_flag/objective_bonus so post-training audits can verify payment count.
forbidden_edits_avoided: Do not increase raw per-step action or engine bonuses.
Do not let objective_bonus exceed roughly one terminal event per episode.
Do not define success only as a non-terminal state predicate if it pays a large reward repeatedly.
do not increase repeatable per-step bonuses without event/progress gating
rejected_patterns_avoided: single_component_dominance: success_bonus is now one-shot, not repeatable.
raw_repeatable_action_bonus: engine bonuses are now conditioned on not being landed (progress gating).
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All four discrete actions remain available. The revised reward does not change action space. The policy should still use all actions for stabilization and descent. The main change is that staying on the pad with both legs contact no longer yields per-step success bonus, so the policy will be incentivized to terminate after landing.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_reward and vertical_speed_reward guide descent. Phase 2 (descent): engine penalties are mild but conditioned on not being landed. Phase 3 (touchdown): success_bonus is one-shot at termination, encouraging the policy to complete the episode after landing.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: success_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met). main_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). orientation_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). All other terms remain per-step but are bounded and small.
